name: zendesk
description: Read-only Zendesk evidence for ecommerce late-order and return reviews.

auth.label: Zendesk OAuth access token
auth.hint: Attach a zendesk credential containing secret_accessToken. Multi-customer distributions require an approved Zendesk global OAuth client. The current OrgSDK host accepts this as a manually managed token; automatic Zendesk OAuth connection is not available.

marketplace.tagline: Read evidence for late orders and return recommendations.
useCases: Correlate order, shipment and support references
Prepare evidence for a human-reviewed recommendation
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Read operations only. No purchases, refunds, messages, updates or credential mutation. Account credentials may independently have broader rights.
